name: Beat Up Verity
desc:
😈 Verity IS bad... now it's time to BEAT HIM UP!

How to Play:
✋ Grab Verity and throw him
🧱 Hit him to get coins
💥 Fill the KO bar to knock him out for MORE coins
🔫 Use fun weapons: Brick, Bat, Sword, Chainsaw, Flamethrower and a MINIGUN!
⬆️ Level up your coins and power
😡 Beat up different Veritys
🌆 Beat him in new places
🎁 Get FREE gifts every day: a free Minigun on Day 7!

🎮 Play on Phone, Tablet and Computer

llm.loop: grab and hit the Verity ragdoll -> earn coins per hit and KO -> buy bigger weapons and power -> beat new Veritys in new places
llm.objectives: knock out Verity for coins and unlock all weapons
llm.progression: coins, power level, weapons, new Verity variants and locations
llm.instructions: grab and throw Verity, hit him for coins, fill the KO bar, use weapons, claim daily gifts
unique: beat-up-a-character stress-relief clicker featuring a meme character
llm.thumbnails: yellow ragdoll figure on a target with weapons: pistol, chainsaw, grenade, minigun
llm.complexity_notes: ragdoll physics on a single character, weapon set, simple maps
